description: CI-V wave-data scope-mode families. radio_owned_window_scope_modes: modes where the radio owns the displayed window — FIX (1), SCROLL-C (2), SCROLL-F (3); 'follow the radio' means the view IS the window the frames report (Center sends centre+span; 1/2/3 send lower/higher edges). span_applicable_scope_modes: modes where SPAN (27 15) selects the window width — Center (0) and SCROLL-C (2); EDGE number (27 16) selects it in FIX (1) and SCROLL-F (3). SCROLL-C is in both families: the window is radio-owned AND span-driven, so a follow span gesture there writes only the span preset. Hand-maintained: change with src/rigplane/runtime/radio_scope_source.py RADIO_OWNED_WINDOW_SCOPE_MODES / SPAN_APPLICABLE_SCOPE_MODES and frontend spectrum-logic.ts isRadioOwnedWindowScope / spectrum-toolbar-logic.ts isSpanApplicable; tests/test_scope_mode_families_contract.py pins the server side, spectrum-panel-logic.test.ts pins the client side.
